title: Extraction of high molecular weight DNA from nasal lining fluid
author: Samuel Montgomery
materials: Increase the temperature to 56 °C and incubate for 01:00:00 in a thermomixer at 500 rpm, °C,

steps.title: Prepare MetaPolyzyme stock
steps.instruction: Reconstitute lyophilized MetaPolyzyme to a final concentration of 5 mg/mL according to the manufacturer, aliquot into 0.6 mL microtubes, and store at –20 °C until use.

steps.title: Make 70% ethanol solution
steps.instruction: Mix molecular‑grade ethanol with UltraPure water to obtain a 70 % (v/v) ethanol solution (approximately 1 mL per sample).

steps.title: Add MetaPolyzyme to sample
steps.instruction: Pipette 5 µL of the 5 mg/mL MetaPolyzyme into 45 µL of nasal lining fluid sample in PBS in a 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Incubate with MetaPolyzyme
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 1 hour at 35 °C in a thermomixer set to 500 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑containing tube
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 mm silica/zirconia beads to a 2.0 mL screw‑cap tube up to the conical line (one tube per sample).

steps.title: Combine sample with beads and lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add approximately 50 µL of the incubated sample to the bead‑containing tube, then add 250 µL Cell Lysis Solution containing 0.6 % (v/v) Proteinase K and 0.6 % (v/v) RNase A.

steps.title: First bead beating
steps.instruction: Bead‑beat the tube in a Precellys 24 for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Ice incubation
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.

steps.title: Second bead beating
steps.instruction: Bead‑beat the tube again for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Centrifuge post‑bead beating
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g (temperature not specified) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer approximately 300 µL of supernatant to a new 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the supernatant for 30 minutes at 37 °C in a thermomixer set to 500 rpm.

steps.title: Cool on ice
steps.instruction: Briefly place the tube on ice until it reaches room temperature.

steps.title: Add protein precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL protein precipitation solution containing 1 % (v/v) GenElute linear polyacrylamide, then invert the tube 25 times to mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Ice incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge protein pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16 000 × g (temperature not specified) for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer cleared supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL LoBind tube without disturbing the protein pellet.

steps.title: Low‑biomass DNA precipitation (PEG)
steps.instruction: For low‑biomass samples, add 1.5 volumes of PEG solution, incubate in the dark at room temperature for 2 hours, then centrifuge at 14 000 × g, 24 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: High‑biomass DNA precipitation (isopropanol)
steps.instruction: For high‑biomass samples, add 1 volume of isopropanol, incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes, then centrifuge at 16 000 × g at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant with a pipette at the air‑liquid interface, avoiding disturbance of the (often invisible) pellet.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL 70 % (v/v) ethanol, invert several times to wash the pellet, then centrifuge at 16 000 × g (temperature not specified) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, add another 400 µL 70 % ethanol, invert, and centrifuge at 16 000 × g (temperature not specified) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Discard the final supernatant and allow the pellet to air‑dry for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL DNA hydration solution or nuclease‑free water to the dried pellet and mix gently.

steps.title: Overnight incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube in a 4 °C refrigerator overnight.

steps.title: Storage and downstream use
steps.instruction: After incubation, DNA is ready for quantification. Store DNA in water at –20 °C or in hydration solution at 4 °C for up to one month.
